summary.text: Derrin R. Owens is a Republican member of the Utah Senate representing District 27, which covers Garfield, Juab, Kane, Millard, Piute, Sanpete, Sevier, Utah, Washington and Wayne counties, and has served since 2015. His official legislative profile lists his profession as executive director of economic development.

paragraphs.text: Owens holds a Master of Education degree.
He sits on the Senate Economic Development and Workforce Services Committee and the Senate Natural Resources, Agriculture, and Environment Committee.
